segments.sn35.159:1.1: “Rūpe, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha; rūpāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha.
segments.sn35.159:1.2: Rūpe, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto, rūpāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto rūpesupi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.159:1.6: Sadde … gandhe … rase … phoṭṭhabbe … dhamme, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha;
segments.sn35.159:1.11: Dhamme, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto, dhammāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto dhammesupi nibbindati.
